brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to assess the effect of dapagliflozin on renal glucose clearance in type 2 diabetic subjects with mild, moderate, and severe renal impairment compared to type 2 diabetic and healthy subjects with normal renal function
brief_title: Renal Impairment in Type 2 Diabetic Subjects

eligibility.criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects in the following groups:

Group A: Healthy Subjects with Normal Renal Function (CLcr \> 80 mL/min) Group B: Diabetic Subjects with Normal Renal Function (CLcr \> 80 mL/min) Group C: Diabetic Subjects with Mild Renal Impairment (CLcr \> 50 - ≤80 mL/min) Group D: Diabetic Subjects with Moderate Renal Impairment (CLcr ≥ 30 - ≤50 mL/min) Group E: Diabetic Subjects with Severe Renal Impairment (CLcr \< 30 mL/min) (and not receiving dialysis)

* Men and WOCBP, ages 18 to 79 years old

Standard Exclusion Criteria, plus:

* History of diabetic ketoacidosis
* HbA\*1c \> 10%
* Serum albumin \< 2.0 gm/dL
* Potassium \< 3.0 or \> 6.0 mEq/L

official_title: The Pharmacodynamics, Pharmacokinetics, and Safety of Dapagliflozin in Type 2 Diabetic Subjects With Mild, Moderate, and Severe Renal Impairment

primary_outcomes.measure: Urine will be collected over a 24 h period for determination of renal glucose clearance, total protein, and measurement of total glucose excreted in urine
Blood samples for serum glucose and creatinine will be collected
primary_outcomes.time_frame: on Days -1, 1, 4 and 10 at selected timepoints

primary_outcomes.measure: Iohexol PK blood & urine samples for GFR assessment
